title: Vic's 2025 year in review: selling Affistash, PodKit exit, and building as purpose
summary: Vic's personal yearly essay covering 2025: scaling Affistash past $6K MRR, launching and selling PodKit to Listener.com, exiting Affistash to FMTC, and joining the ClujHouse builder community. Mostly narrative, with reflections on money, purpose, and why he builds.

principles.text: Chasing money to make people love you is the wrong mindset; a health scare reframed it.
principles.quote: The last thing I want is having the mentality that I had back at 16-17 chasing money and thinking that would somehow make everyone love me.

principles.text: Building is a purpose independent of outcome; the drive to create persists whether ideas succeed or fail.
principles.quote: This year I also realised that the purpose of my life is to create. Whether it succeeds, or it completely fails, I’ll always feel the need to bring my ideas into the world.

principles.text: Finding a community of like-minded builders ends isolation and is a major unlock.
principles.quote: I met some amazing, smart and like minded folks that I could nerd out with, and it felt amazing.

principles.text: Launch fast and get revenue immediately; PodKit made money the same week it launched.
principles.quote: in February we launched PodKit, and we got revenue the same week :)

principles.text: Sharing wins publicly can spark conversations that lead to acquisitions.
principles.quote: This tweet also sparked the discussion that led to my first acquisition this year

principles.text: Ambition compounds: the higher he gets, the more he wants to climb, and he embraces it.
principles.quote: Strangely, the higher I get, the more I want to climb, but I accepted this idea, and I fully embrace it.
